headlines.title: Poll: Americans are anxious, pessimistic and deeply unhappy with Trump ahead of the midterms
headlines.description: Weeks ahead of Election Day, 71% of U.S. adults think the country is on the “wrong track.”

headlines.title: Is Iowa a Battleground Again?
headlines.description: How the Hawkeye State became one of the most closely watched battlegrounds of the midterms

headlines.title: Zelenskyy says waived Russian sanctions are 'strengthening Putin's war against us'
headlines.description: In an exclusive interview with Meet the Press, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says that President Trump's decision to waive Lindsey Graham’s Russia sanctions law shows "really big support for Putin."

headlines.title: Large Military Base Fire in Canada Leaves Several Dead
headlines.description: Several people have been killed and many others rushed to local hospitals after an incident sparked a large fire on a military base in Alberta. Canada’s defense minister has described the situation as “very, very active and delicate” but officials have not said exactly what caused the blaze.

headlines.title: Pope Leo Delivers Sunday Prayer After Cancer Surgery
headlines.description: Pope Leo XIV appeared in public just one day after he was discharged from the hospital for lung surgery. The Chicago-born Pontiff left the hospital on Saturday with his doctors saying he is recovering well. NBC’s Anne Thompson reports for Sunday TODAY.

headlines.title: 1,200 Arrested After Sweeping Protests Turn Violent in France
headlines.description: A major cleanup is underway in France after demonstrations involving more than half a million people protesting rising costs and poor conditions in the country’s schools turned chaotic. Officials say 1,200 people were arrested after violent clashes in Paris and other cities throughout France.

headlines.title: Two dead, others injured after truck drives through Kansas soccer game
headlines.description: An adult and a child have died and nearly a dozen others are injured after a pick-up truck drove through a youth soccer game in Wichita, Kansas, according to police.

headlines.title: ‘The house was toast’: Surf swallows California homes
headlines.description: The worst of El Niño is still months away, but Southern California’s fragile coastline is already being transformed by record-setting king tides and storm surges.

headlines.title: Miley Cyrus Honors Late Godmother Dolly Parton With Emotional Performance
headlines.description: Miley Cyrus performed a passionate rendition of her “Aunt Dolly’s” classic “Jolene” during her performance at the Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles.

headlines.title: Service member dies after falling during pregame demonstration at college football game
headlines.description: A service member fell during a pregame aerial demonstration in San Antonio on Saturday night and later died at a hospital, according to military officials and video verified by NBC News.

headlines.title: Treasury secretary refuses to say if the U.S. sees Ukraine as an ally
headlines.description: Amid escalating tensions between President Donald Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on Sunday dodged three times when asked whether Ukraine is an ally of the United States.
